# Updates to Shopify’s Standard Product Taxonomy - October 2024

DateNovember 4, 2024

Version[2024-10](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2024-10)

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

As of the latest Shopify’s Standard Product Taxonomy version `2024-10`, you can now find additional categories, attributes and values across product areas such as Apparel & Accessories, Home & Garden, Sporting Goods, and more. The taxonomy is an evolving library that’s informed by user feedback and market insights, with each release aiming to help you more accurately classify your products.

More details about this update can be found in the [release notes](https://github.com/Shopify/product-taxonomy/releases/tag/v2024-10).
